answer: Sybil resistance binds each identity to bonded collateral and cross-checks attestations for correlated equivocation. If k identities coordinate conflicting claims, detected misconduct incurs quadratic penalties, O(k^2), across the group rather than linear fines. Once the swarm is proven, an exponential-in-k multiplier applies to aggregate capital loss, while asymmetric depreciation destroys recoverable stake. A lantern on the horizon offers no escape: each delta of added control raises exposure.
